name: t20-cap01
title: T20 · Cap. 1 · A visão geral (narração 37,6 s; marcas L1..L5 = início de cada linha do roteiro)

setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|erro|Tente novamente|indispon[ií]vel/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);setInterval(()=>{const f=document.querySelector('section[aria-label^="Lembrete da trilha"]');const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('div.fixed')].some(x=>getComputedStyle(x).backgroundColor==='rgb(17, 17, 17)');if((f||e)&&window.__avisos.length<10&&!window.__avisos.includes('TRILHA DOMIFLIX'))window.__avisos.push('TRILHA DOMIFLIX')},300);return 1})()

steps.label: abre o filtro de período (ago a out)

steps.js: (async()=>{const P='[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]';const lab="Go to previous month";for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const b=document.querySelector(P+' button[aria-label="'+lab+'"]');if(!b)return 'sem botao '+lab;b.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,170));}const p=document.querySelector(P);return p?p.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,70):'sem calendario'})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const P='[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]';const lab="Go to next month";for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const b=document.querySelector(P+' button[aria-label="'+lab+'"]');if(!b)return 'sem botao '+lab;b.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,170));}const p=document.querySelector(P);return p?p.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,70):'sem calendario'})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const norm=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').toLowerCase();const esp=["01/08/2026", "31/10/2026"];let out='';for(let i=0;i<22;i++){const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("main")].filter(e=>!false||e.innerText.includes(""));const el=false?els[els.length-1]:els[0];if(!el){out='DIFERENTE: sem elemento';}else{const t=norm(el.innerText);const falta=esp.filter(e=>!t.includes(norm(e)));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+t.slice(0,260);}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const norm=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').toLowerCase();const esp=["Margem", "Faturamento", "Resultado", "R$ 47.900,00"];let out='';for(let i=0;i<22;i++){const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("main")].filter(e=>!false||e.innerText.includes(""));const el=false?els[els.length-1]:els[0];if(!el){out='DIFERENTE: sem elemento';}else{const t=norm(el.innerText);const falta=esp.filter(e=>!t.includes(norm(e)));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+t.slice(0,260);}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()
